reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2, E3) supports the mechanism of dislocation transmission and the achievement of strength/ductility via SCCPs in a specific W-based HEA, but it does not address the WTaCrVHf composition, radiation tolerance, or the link between mechanical integrity and radiation tolerance.
premises: Coherent nanoprecipitation interfaces facilitate dislocation transmission and stress relief
Stepwise controllable coherent nanoprecipitations (SCCPs) can be achieved in tungsten refractory HEAs
SCCPs produce ultrahigh strength and ductility in a W-based HEA
The SCCP strategy is applicable to a quinary WTaCrVHf alloy
Improved mechanical integrity from SCCPs translates to improved radiation tolerance
